::: {#sol-bikeshare-mean}

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

##### R

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
# The sample mean of the hourly counts, from the data loaded above.
bikers_mean <- mean(bikeshare_raw$bikers)
round(bikers_mean, 2)
```

##### Python

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
# The sample mean of the hourly counts, from the data loaded above.
bikers_mean = float(bikeshare_raw["bikers"].mean())
round(bikers_mean, 2)
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
bikers_mean_round <- round(bikers_mean, 1)
```

The [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of `bikers` is `r bikers_mean_round` bikes per hour.
A [Poisson regression model](poisson-regression.qmd#def-poisson-regression) with no [covariates](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate) would [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) the [expected](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) hourly count by this sample mean.

:::
